title: Influence of preoperative focused echocardiography on anesthesiologic management in the setting of urgent operative fracture care in adults - a multicentric observational trial
summary: The aim of this observational study, which is being conducted at several hospitals, is to investigate the extent to which a cardiac ultrasound examination prior to general anesthesia in adult patients with fractures of long bones changes the anesthetic management around the operation.
conditions: Fractures involving multiple regions of upper limb(s) with lower limb(s)

interventions.name: Performance of a perioperative hemodynamically focused transthoracic echocardiography (PFE) according to the recommendations of the German Society of Anesthesiology and Intensive Care Medicine (DGAI) prior to  urgent surgical fracture care of a large tubular bone under general anesthesia in adult pa

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Guideline-compliant surgery for the treatment of a fracture of a large tubular bone (Femur, Humerus, Radius, Ulna, Tibia, Fibula) under general anaesthesia of any surgical urgency classification; patients capable of giving informed written consent; Age >= 65 years
Exclusion criteria:
Participation in another prospective interventional study involving the cardiovascular system; placement by court or official order; previous participation in TRANSONIC; patients who do not speak German
